evidence_items.explanation: The release establishes concrete corporate activity in world models and physical reasoning. It supports exploration beyond pure text LLMs, without establishing neural-symbolic architecture or industry-wide urgency.

The paper documents an active program combining LLMs with explicit formal models and automated reasoning. It establishes the authors' work and stated commitment, not the general truth of their claim that this integration is essential.
